entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a paradigmatic concept in contemporary technology that has revolutionized the way we perceive and interact with everyday physical objects. Emerging from the convergence of the Internet, sensor technologies, and automation, IoT has enabled the creation of a vast, interconnected network of devices that can collect, process, and exchange data in real-time. This infrastructure has far-reaching implications for various sectors, including manufacturing, healthcare, and energy management, and has the potential to transform the way we live, work, and govern ourselves. As the IoT continues to evolve, it is likely to have a profound impact on the global economy, social structures, and individual freedoms, making it a crucial entity to understand in the context of modern history.
